svg.title: vrp-1 product blueprint: complex planning through actual execution
svg.desc: Five connected stages: model scenarios, prepare geography, inspect explained plans, validate adoption, and replan during execution. Details cover task dependencies, map packages, adoption boundaries, and version lineage. Saved scenarios, frozen input, candidates, published plans, and execution facts remain distinct.
svg.text: Connect complex planning to actual execution.
Multiple scenarios · rich constraints · real roads · explained candidates · fact-driven replanning
WORKFLOW / Explicit input, adoption baselines, and execution facts

g.title: Row i is the origin and column j is the destination. The marked cell gives the travel time from i to j. Three delivery routes appear on the map.

svg.text: Facts → remaining work → candidate → validate adoption
DATA LINEAGE / Retain inputs, decisions, and the work that actually happened
Parent / child tasks and success dependencies are recorded separately.
Shared CPU / memory · queue / progress / cancel · retry · artifact downloads
Road packages: PBF → graph → matrices / routes
Basemaps: PMTiles → local styles / fonts / icons
Inspect coverage, provenance, versions, size, references
Prepare basemaps independently of solves / adoption
Actual positions, loads, and cargo ownership bound the remaining problem.
Recheck capacity, reachability, load order, prerequisites, commitments.
Event-driven replanning and automatic adoption are separate settings.
Scenarios and audit / retain each decision baseline
Independent drafts; saving creates a new version
Problem, matrix, options, result, and score trends
Actor, execution baseline, plan version, and changes
Departure, arrival, service, completion, cargo events
Four connected workspaces for every scenario
Workbench / HTTP API / CLI / Rust library share contracts and the compute engine.
